report_sections.text: {first_name} meets DSM-5 criteria for Bipolar 1 (Manic Episode)
{pronouns.subject} reports having experienced following:

bullet_points.text: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated mood

During this period, {first_name} reported abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.
{pronouns.subject} reported that the mood disturbance and elevated activity lasted at least a week and was present most of the day during this period.

Decreased need for sleep

Flight of ideas or felt that {pronouns.possessive} thoughts were racing

Increased goal directed activity

These episodes were uncharacteristic of {pronouns.possessive} normal functioning
